A court will most likely not enforce the bar against the assignment of the $30,000 right to payment. A general prohibition on assigning "the contract" is read as barring only delegation of performance (UCC §2-210(3); Restatement (Second) of Contracts §322), and for a sale of goods, UCC §9-406(d) makes a term barring assignment of payment rights ineffective against the assignee. The treatment center can still pay the distributor until it receives notice, and the distributor could face a breach claim for damages, but the transfer itself should stand, subject to governing law and any wording that expressly covers payment rights.

CONFIDENCE: 72
